name: Maximum Sum Increasing Subsequence
statement:
1. You are given a number n, representing the number of elements.
2. You are given n numbers, representing the contents of array of length n.
3. You are required to print the sum of elements of the increasing subsequence with maximum sum for the array.
inputFormat:
A number n
.. n more elements
outputFormat: A number representing the sum of elements of the increasing subsequence with maximum sum for the array.
